text.en: Its peak is very short: sometimes it lasts only a few hours.
text.es: Su pico es muy breve: a veces dura solo unas horas.

text.en: Its peak is very short: sometimes it lasts only a few hours.
text.es: Su pico es muy breve: a veces dura solo unas horas.

text.en: Its name comes from Quadrans Muralis, a former constellation created in 1795.
text.es: Su nombre viene de Quadrans Muralis, una constelación creada en 1795 que ya no existe.
